notes.summary: Independent full-page reading: one whole-page view, then one view of each supplied half in order, then 15 own tight crops. C and H were checked against every manuscript line. No other reader material, other scan, OCR, external source, or research was used. The main H errors occur in the opening question, the Déjà paragraph, the final condition of Corollary 1, and correction states. C remains close overall but has several unresolved or revised state readings. Differences in equivalent macro names alone were not counted; marked_in_h means H signals uncertainty/unread text or explicitly annotates the relevant issue, not merely that it uses a deletion macro.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No theorem or corollary was proved. Recognizing that three written expressions refer to a family/product map prompted scrutiny of the last short connector; the expected map did not supply an arrowhead. In C4 the visible word des was selected from its final stroke, not from a claim about components. The visible two-bar sign was kept without expanding it to même. No mathematical correctness assumption was used to repair the page.
notes.author_checks: No explicit author proof-check annotation is present. C4 and the three corollaries are transcribed as written, with the old lettered cases canceled. The interlinear necessity/sufficiency statement is partly uncertain in its correction state. Cancellations and insertions are recorded, not interpreted as validation of the assertions.
notes.title_dates_pagination: The top-centre handwritten page number is 64; the scan is 65. No title, date, archive sheet number, stamp, or stated page total is visible on this leaf. No independent mathematical diagram or drawing is present. The angular mark around Cor. 2 is an insertion connector; its role is encoded by the inserted heading and described in the inventory, rather than treated as a mathematical drawing.
